capabilities: Roll dice by clicking die icons or inline dice-notation code blocks, with advantage/disadvantage and color options
Draw from a built-in 52-card deck, jokers, and an oracle major arcana deck
Build custom image decks from folders or image URLs, with rotation (flip) options
Generate random words and roll custom random tables built from vault notes, with templates, weights, and a cut-up method mode
Render inline dynamic counters, progress trackers (boxes and clocks), and tab stops in notes
extras: Inline elements (counters, trackers, dice, tab stops) are disabled by default and must be enabled in plugin settings. Installation is via GitHub release download or building from source (Node 18+), with manual updates replacing the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for tabletop RPG sessions, such as dice, oracle decks, random tables, or progress trackers for solo play.

relations.evidence: This feature can be useful with products like "The GameMaster's Apprentice" VTT decks

summary: A toolkit for tabletop RPG play with a dice roller, card decks, random generators and tables, and inline counters and trackers, aimed at solo play with a GM emulator.
